arithmetic: Exact rational quantities; ceil each shift separately; no binary-float rounding

legacy_rule.future_activation: Separate Owner-authorized version selection, source binding, compatibility tests and explicit migration; never silent override

missing_shift_allocation: OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED; never infer equal allocation or derive a missing shift
optional_consistency_input: DAILY_PACKAGED_KG must equal both shift quantities added
product_mass_rule: Raw inbound fruit is not packaged-product mass. A documented upstream conversion is needed; this offline module does not invent or calculate yield.
source_verification_limit: Requires and records an explicit mass-basis/reference; it does not authenticate external files or create server authority.
staffing_semantics: Independent shift employee sets; no lockers shared. No other job staff and no intra-shift changing batches.
zero_mass: Zero assigned product yields zero packaging staff for that shift; not proof a real facility needs no other workers
